value_descriptions.false: Leave the diagnostic logger disabled.
value_descriptions.true: Enable diagnostic logging for troubleshooting.

bioseq.testing.chunked_scanner.enabled.purpose: Selects a synthetic sequence scanner in test builds.

value_descriptions.false: Use the normal scanner selection.
value_descriptions.true: Force the synthetic chunked-input route where supported.

bioseq.testing.in_memory_scanner.enabled.purpose: Selects an in-memory input scanner in test builds.

value_descriptions.false: Use the normal scanner selection.
value_descriptions.true: Materialize sequence input before scanner dispatch.

bioseq.testing.persisted_index.failure_m.purpose: Injects a persisted-index reader failure for tests.

value_descriptions.unsupported_vector_shape: Make the adapter report an unsupported vector shape.

bioseq.storage.compression.algorithm.purpose: Chooses the compression codec for newly created column-storage options.

value_descriptions.zstd: Use Zstandard when compiled in. This is the preferred build-time default.
value_descriptions.lz4: Use LZ4 when compiled in. This becomes the default when Zstandard is unavailable.
value_descriptions.pglz: Use PostgreSQL's PGLZ codec. This is the default when neither optional codec is compiled in.

bioseq.storage.compression.algorithm.notes: Changing the default does not rewrite existing table data.

bioseq.storage.compression.level.purpose: Sets the Zstandard compression level for new storage options. The current PGLZ and LZ4 paths do not use this level.

bioseq.storage.stripe.row_limit.purpose: Sets the maximum rows in a new table's column stripe. Existing table options and stored stripes are unchanged.

bioseq.storage.chunk_group.row_limit.purpose: Sets the maximum rows in a new table's chunk group. Chunk groups divide a stripe into smaller column-reading units.

bioseq.storage.dml.enabled.purpose: Controls whether reads apply deleted-row masks.

value_descriptions.true: Hide rows that have been deleted or replaced. Keep this enabled for ordinary queries.
value_descriptions.false: Bypass deletion-mask filtering. This is a diagnostic control, not a read-only mode.

bioseq.execution.parallel.enabled.purpose: Controls PostgreSQL parallel-scan alternatives in the planner.

value_descriptions.true: Allow eligible parallel scan paths. Actual worker availability still depends on PostgreSQL.
value_descriptions.false: Do not add those parallel scan alternatives.

bioseq.execution.parallel.enabled.notes: This does not make alignment custom scans parallel-safe.

bioseq.execution.parallel.minimum_proces.purpose: Requests the PostgreSQL worker count for eligible Bioseq parallel scan paths. Despite its name, this does not reserve or guarantee a minimum number of launched workers.

bioseq.vectorization.enabled.purpose: Controls supported SQL filter and aggregate vectorization.

value_descriptions.true: Use supported vectorized SQL operations when the plan permits them.
value_descriptions.false: Use scalar SQL processing for those operations.

bioseq.vectorization.enabled.notes: Minimizer and chaining algorithms have separate selectors.

bioseq.column_cache.enabled.purpose: Controls the backend's decompressed column-chunk cache.

value_descriptions.true: Cache eligible decompressed buffers during scanning.
value_descriptions.false: Read and decompress without retaining buffers in this cache.

bioseq.column_cache.enabled.notes: Normal scan teardown clears this cache. It is distinct from the query-result cache.

bioseq.column_cache.capacity_mb.purpose: Limits the decompressed column-chunk cache. Buffers in use remain protected, so this is not a limit on total backend memory.

bioseq.planner.index_scan.enabled.purpose: Controls Bioseq's handling of PostgreSQL index-scan paths on table columns.

value_descriptions.true: Permit supported index-scan integration.
value_descriptions.false: Disable that planner integration.

bioseq.planner.index_scan.enabled.notes: This does not control minimizer-index reuse.

value_descriptions.true: Allow the planner to install Bioseq custom scans.
value_descriptions.false: Disable their construction. Ordinary mmsearch has no slower standalone scalar-function fallback.

bioseq.planner.custom_scan.max_paths.purpose: Bounds the custom-scan path alternatives explored for one relation, including parameterized predicate combinations.

bioseq.planner.qual_pushdown.enabled.purpose: Controls supported predicate pushdown into custom scans.

value_descriptions.true: Consider moving eligible filters into the scan.
value_descriptions.false: Leave these filters outside the pushed-down scan work.

bioseq.planner.qual_pushdown.correlation.purpose: Sets the minimum absolute column correlation used by the pushdown decision. Values closer to one demand stronger correlation.

bioseq.planner.diagnostics.log_level.purpose: Chooses the PostgreSQL severity for planner diagnostic messages.
bioseq.planner.diagnostics.log_level.notes: PostgreSQL's message thresholds determine where the messages appear.

bioseq.planner.sequence_sort_scan.enable.purpose: Controls the experimental sequence batch-sort scan.

value_descriptions.false: Leave ordinary sort planning in place.
value_descriptions.true: Consider the custom batch-sort path for eligible single sequence sort keys.

bioseq.index.insert_maintenance.enabled.purpose: Gates automatic index maintenance requested by each stored index policy.

value_descriptions.false: Save new source rows without automatic index builds.
value_descriptions.true: Maintain enabled on-insert indexes. Ordinary INSERT rejects grouped minimizer maintenance. Streamed loading has a separate batched build path.

bioseq.index.insert_maintenance.enabled.notes: Explicit update_index does not depend on this gate.

value_descriptions.true: Permit compatible stored reads where the executor supports them.
value_descriptions.false: Skip optional persisted reads and compute needed data during execution.

bioseq.index.sequence_read.enabled.notes: Per-search index_read_requirement codes 1 and 2 override this choice. It never builds an index.

value_descriptions.false: Do not stage asynchronous persistence work.
value_descriptions.true: Allow the limited ordinary-MPS submission path when its other requirements are met.

bioseq.index.async_persistence.enabled.notes: Grouped explicit builds require this setting off.

bioseq.index.recompute_async_persistence.purpose: Controls deferred persistence requests after a query recomputes minimizers.

value_descriptions.false: Keep recomputation separate from deferred persistence.
value_descriptions.true: Allow eligible requests when async_persistence is also on. This does not promise that an index will be saved.

bioseq.index.recompute_async_persistence.notes: Grouped explicit builds require this setting off.

bioseq.index.memory_cap_mb.purpose: Adds a cap on accounted resident-index reservations. Zero uses the common runtime memory budget. Other query buffers are outside this index count.

bioseq.index.sequence_minimizer_sort.alg.purpose: Chooses the pair sorter for ordinary MPS builds.

value_descriptions.simd_u128_vqsort: Use Highway VQSort on packed 128-bit keys.
value_descriptions.simd_u128_vec_stream_1: Use the SIMD sorter with one vector stream.
value_descriptions.simd_u128_vec_stream_2: Use the SIMD sorter with two vector streams.
value_descriptions.simd_u128_vec_stream_4: Use the SIMD sorter with four vector streams.

bioseq.index_build.run_buffer_bytes.purpose: Overrides the external-sort run buffer size. Zero computes a size from the process memory budget and index cap. This is an administrative tuning control.

bioseq.load.write_overlap.enabled.purpose: Controls overlap between input decoding and table writes during loading.

value_descriptions.false: Use the ordinary loading schedule.
value_descriptions.true: Overlap decoding with writing through a bounded queue. The PostgreSQL backend still performs table writes.

bioseq.aligner.minimizer.kmer_size.purpose: Sets the number of sequence symbols in each k-mer. The selected algorithm and compiled profile impose additional restrictions.

bioseq.aligner.minimizer.window_size.purpose: Sets the number of consecutive k-mers in one minimizer window. It does not count sequence symbols.

bioseq.aligner.minimizer.algorithm.purpose: Chooses how query and target minimizers are extracted.

value_descriptions.bounded_nthash_simd: Use the bounded SIMD ntHash implementation. Execution requires a supported generated profile.
value_descriptions.simd_minimap2_reference: Use the SIMD implementation of minimap2's integer-hash sketch semantics where supported.
value_descriptions.two_stack_nthash: Use rolling ntHash and two-stack window-minimum maintenance.
value_descriptions.vulkan_minimap_integer: Use Vulkan integer-hash minimizer extraction on a supported device and execution route.

bioseq.aligner.minimizer.algorithm.notes: Changing the algorithm can invalidate compatibility with saved indexes.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.maximum_gap.purpose: Sets the requested maximum anchor gap used by chaining. Scalar chaining raises this limit to at least the bandwidth.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.maximum_referenc.purpose: Stores a separate reference-gap request. This field currently has no execution consumer, so changing it does not add a separate reference-gap rule.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.bandwidth.purpose: Bounds query-versus-target gap differences in chainers that use a diagonal band. Alignment paths also consume this parameter.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.long_join_bandwi.purpose: Stores a long-join bandwidth request. This field currently has no execution consumer and does not enable a long-join pass.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.maximum_skipped_.purpose: Sets the selected chainer's early-stop limit for predecessor search. SQL SIMD chaining requires a positive value even though the GUC accepts zero.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.maximum_predeces.purpose: Bounds the predecessor window for scan-based chainers. Scalar chaining can examine one additional candidate. RMQ does not use this field.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.minimum_seed_cou.purpose: Sets the minimum seed count for an accepted chain. It is a chain threshold, not a required number of SQL result rows.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.minimum_score.purpose: Sets the minimum accepted chain score. The score is computed by the selected chaining algorithm.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.gap_penalty_scal.purpose: Scales the gap penalty used by chaining. Larger values penalize that contribution more strongly.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.skip_penalty_sca.purpose: Scales the chaining skip-distance penalty. Zero removes this scaled contribution.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.algorithm.purpose: Chooses how matching seed anchors become chains.

value_descriptions.simd_minimap2: Use the bounded SIMD batch policy. Its approximation need not reproduce scalar chains exactly.
value_descriptions.range_minimum_query: Use the range-minimum-query chainer instead of scanning the ordinary predecessor window.
value_descriptions.vulkan_tiled_dynamic_programming: Use tiled GPU dynamic-programming chaining on a supported Vulkan route.

bioseq.aligner.chaining.algorithm.notes: A valid selector does not make every hardware and input combination executable.

bioseq.aligner.secondary.overlap_thresho.purpose: Sets the primary/secondary classification threshold combining query-interval overlap with uncovered query length. It is not simply a percentage of shared bases.

bioseq.aligner.secondary.uncovered_lengt.purpose: Limits the uncovered query length used when classifying an alignment as secondary to an existing primary.

bioseq.aligner.secondary.score_ratio_thr.purpose: Sets the secondary-to-primary score-ratio threshold. Zero bypasses this filtering step, including its secondary-count limit.

bioseq.aligner.secondary.maximum_count.purpose: Limits retained secondary alignments across the complete list passed to the filtering stage. It is not a SQL LIMIT and is bypassed when the score-ratio threshold is zero.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.match_score.purpose: Sets the score added for an aligned matching symbol.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.mismatch_penalty.purpose: Sets the score penalty for an aligned mismatch.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.short_gap_open_pe.purpose: Sets the first gap-opening penalty. KSW2 and BlockAligner use this pair. BlockAligner requires positive opening and extension penalties whose sum is at most 128.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.short_gap_extensi.purpose: Sets the first gap-extension penalty. BlockAligner requires it to be positive and its sum with the first opening penalty to be at most 128.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.long_gap_open_pen.purpose: Sets KSW2's second gap-opening penalty. Native BlockAligner uses only the first gap-penalty pair.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.long_gap_extensio.purpose: Sets KSW2's second gap-extension penalty. Native BlockAligner does not use this second pair.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.ambiguous_base_pe.purpose: Sets the alignment penalty for ambiguous symbols on paths that support them.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.z_drop_threshold.purpose: Sets KSW2's Z-drop threshold or BlockAligner's X-drop threshold for end extensions. BlockAligner extensions require a nonnegative value.

bioseq.aligner.scoring.end_bonus.purpose: Sets KSW2's sequence-end bonus. Negative one disables the bonus. Native BlockAligner does not use it.

bioseq.aligner.seeding.maximum_occurrenc.purpose: Excludes minimizer keys with more target occurrences than this limit. A direct persisted reader also requires the request to fit its saved occurrence limit.

bioseq.aligner.seeding.intermediate_occu.purpose: Stores an intermediate seed-occurrence threshold. This field currently has no execution consumer, so it does not perform another filtering pass.

bioseq.aligner.block_alignment.minimum_b.purpose: Sets BlockAligner's minimum adaptive block size. After widening to the active SIMD lane count, block sizes must be powers of two and the minimum cannot exceed the maximum.

bioseq.aligner.block_alignment.maximum_b.purpose: Sets BlockAligner's maximum adaptive block size. Its effective size must be a power of two and at least the effective minimum.

bioseq.aligner.base_alignment.algorithm.purpose: Chooses the base-alignment implementation when requested results need this stage.

value_descriptions.block_aligner: Use adaptive block alignment with the first gap-penalty pair.
value_descriptions.ksw2: Use KSW2 with its banded extension and two gap-penalty pairs.

bioseq.aligner.base_alignment.algorithm.notes: Selecting an implementation does not itself request CIGAR or base-alignment output.

bioseq.aligner.fragment_minimizer.lookup.purpose: Chooses how a grouped MPF reader finds a query hash.

value_descriptions.direct_compact_hash_lookup: Use the saved direct section for supported 32-bit hash domains. Wider hashes use fragment controls.
value_descriptions.control_block_scan: Search the grouped controls in the mapped fragment arrays.

bioseq.aligner.fragment_minimizer.lookup.notes: The required compatible file must already exist. This is not a PostgreSQL hash index.

bioseq.aligner.grouped_soa_generation.en.purpose: Selects the representation produced by explicit minimizer-index builds.

value_descriptions.true: Publish grouped generations. MPF also publishes its immutable reader file.
value_descriptions.false: Use the older ordinary representation where the chosen algorithm supports it.

bioseq.aligner.grouped_soa_generation.en.notes: Changing this setting alone builds or converts nothing. Grouped builds require both asynchronous switches off.

bioseq.aligner.vulkan.enabled.purpose: Permits execution of selected Vulkan algorithms.

value_descriptions.true: Allow supported GPU work. This does not select a GPU algorithm by itself.
value_descriptions.false: Disallow Vulkan execution. Explicit GPU requests fail instead of silently changing algorithms.

bioseq.aligner.vulkan.enabled.notes: An explicit per-search true value also requests a standalone GPU prefilter in an eligible scan.

value_descriptions.false: Do not select GPU seed lookup through this switch.
value_descriptions.true: Request GPU seed lookup subject to the supported route and device requirements.

bioseq.aligner.vulkan.index_cache.enable.purpose: Controls reuse of GPU-resident minimizer-index uploads.

value_descriptions.true: Retain compatible device index data for reuse on a selected GPU seed route.
value_descriptions.false: Do not reuse uploads through this GPU index cache.

bioseq.aligner.vulkan.fused_frontend.ena.purpose: Selects the resident fused Vulkan frontend.

value_descriptions.false: Leave this frontend unselected.
value_descriptions.true: Request fused device frontend work as part of a supported Vulkan execution route.

value_descriptions.false: Do not request GPU construction through this switch.
value_descriptions.true: Request device target-index construction when the remaining Vulkan route requirements are met.

bioseq.aligner.vulkan.alignment_extensio.purpose: Selects the GPU base-alignment extension stage.

value_descriptions.false: Do not request GPU extension.
value_descriptions.true: Permit the extension stage on a supported Vulkan route. GPU CIGAR output requires this stage.

bioseq.aligner.vulkan.ordered_sketch_til.purpose: Stores an ordered-sketch tile-size request. It is copied into parameters but currently has no execution consumer.

bioseq.aligner.vulkan.radix_sort_digit_b.purpose: Stores a device radix-sort digit width. It is copied into parameters but currently has no execution consumer.

value_descriptions.false: Run without the optional profiling collection.
value_descriptions.true: Collect pipeline profiling information. Instrumentation can alter execution scheduling and measured cost.

bioseq.scheduler.backend.max_concurrency.purpose: Caps participating task slots in each backend. Zero uses the available CPU count. The participating caller counts toward the cap. This is not a cluster-wide worker quota.

bioseq.scheduler.pipeline.mode.purpose: Chooses where the task scheduler may run work concurrently.

value_descriptions.task_parallel: Allow eligible parallel regions inside the pipeline as well as parallel dispatch.
value_descriptions.single_thread: Run dispatch and coarse pipeline work on the caller.
value_descriptions.parallel_dispatch: Allow independent eligible dispatch jobs to overlap, without selecting internal task-parallel regions.

bioseq.scheduler.pipeline.mode.notes: Input access, batch size and memory admission can still limit parallelism.

bioseq.scheduler.postgres_parallel.enabl.purpose: Controls task concurrency inside a PostgreSQL parallel-worker process.

value_descriptions.false: Restrict that process to one task slot.
value_descriptions.true: Allow it to use multiple task slots within the backend concurrency cap.

bioseq.storage.sequence_shard.max_size_g.purpose: Sets the sequence-shard size limit. A positive limit must accommodate one complete sequence. Zero starts a new shard for each insertion. Existing sequences are not moved.

bioseq_cache.query_cache.mode.purpose: Selects reuse by the optional query-result-cache extension.

value_descriptions.disabled: Do not use the query-result cache.
value_descriptions.exact_query: Reuse completed identical requests and coordinate concurrent identical computations.
value_descriptions.reusable_fragments: Permit completed-fragment reuse for providers that support it. The Bioseq alignment adapter currently supports exact reuse only.

bioseq_cache.query_cache.mode.notes: Non-disabled modes require shared preloading and a server restart.

bioseq_cache.query_cache.completed_resul.purpose: Limits the age of a completed cached result, measured from completion. Zero prevents ordinary later reuse. An already-registered waiter can still consume completion once. It is not a query timeout.
